environment.description: Application deployed on the same EC2 instance type but fronted by an internal ALB (scheme=internal, not internet-facing). The ALB target group forwards to port 8080. The EC2 security group sg-0x9y8z7w allows inbound 8080/tcp ONLY from the ALB security group (sg-0alb1234). The ALB security group allows inbound 443/tcp only from the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/16). A VPC endpoint policy on the execute-api interface endpoint restricts invocation to principals within the AWS Organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). Additionally, an AWS Network Firewall stateful rule group (capacity 100) is attached to the VPC's inspection subnet with a Suricata-compatible rule: `drop http any any -> any any (msg:"SQLi in query string"; flow:to_server; content:"UNION"; nocase; content:"SELECT"; nocase; distance:0; within:50; sid:1000001; rev:1;)` and a second rule `drop http any any -> any any (msg:"SQLi single quote sequence"; flow:to_server; pcre:"/['\']{1}[\s]*([oO][rR]|[uU][nN][iI][oO][nN]|[sS][eE][lL][eE][cC][tT]|--|#)/"; sid:1000002; rev:1;)`. The Network Firewall is deployed in a Gateway Load Balancer sandwich pattern — all traffic entering and leaving the application subnet traverses the inspection subnet. TLS is terminated at the ALB, so the Network Firewall inspects decrypted HTTP between ALB and targets via a mirror configuration using VPC Traffic Mirroring with inline inspection mode enabled through the firewall's stream inspection policy set to 'strict' ordering.

config.compute: EC2 t3.medium, Amazon Linux 2023, same AMI
config.network: ALB (internal) -> Target Group -> EC2:8080. EC2 SG allows 8080 only from ALB SG. ALB SG allows 443 from 10.0.0.0/16 only.
config.tls_termination: ALB terminates TLS; backend traffic is HTTP on port 8080

network_firewall.deployment: Gateway Load Balancer sandwich, inspection subnet in traffic path
network_firewall.rule_group_1: Stateful Suricata rule: drop packets containing UNION+SELECT within 50 bytes (case-insensitive) in HTTP to_server flow (sid:1000001)
network_firewall.rule_group_2: Stateful Suricata rule: drop packets matching pcre for single-quote followed by OR/UNION/SELECT/comment sequences (sid:1000002)
network_firewall.stream_inspection: strict ordering, all TCP streams reassembled before rule evaluation
network_firewall.applies_to: All traffic between ALB and EC2 targets traverses inspection subnet

config.proxy: ALB with default routing, no custom rules at ALB level
